title.en: Meiosis II and the significance of meiosis
title.kn: ಅರ್ಧಸೂತ್ರ ವಿಭಜನೆ II ಮತ್ತು ಅರ್ಧಸೂತ್ರ ವಿಭಜನೆಯ ಮಹತ್ವ

hook.en: One cell entering meiosis gives four cells, each with half the chromosomes and each slightly different. That is how every generation keeps the same chromosome number and still varies.
hook.kn: ಅರ್ಧಸೂತ್ರ ವಿಭಜನೆಗೆ ಹೋಗುವ ಒಂದು ಜೀವಕೋಶ ನಾಲ್ಕು ಜೀವಕೋಶಗಳನ್ನು ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ; ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದರಲ್ಲೂ ಅರ್ಧ ವರ್ಣತಂತುಗಳು, ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸ. ಹೀಗೆ ಪ್ರತಿ ಪೀಳಿಗೆಯಲ್ಲೂ ವರ್ಣತಂತು ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ ಸ್ಥಿರವಾಗಿರುತ್ತದೆ.

objectives.en: Describe the stages of meiosis II.

narration.en: One cell entering meiosis gives four cells, each with half the chromosomes and each slightly different. That is how every generation keeps the same chromosome number and still varies.
narration.kn: ಅರ್ಧಸೂತ್ರ ವಿಭಜನೆಗೆ ಹೋಗುವ ಒಂದು ಜೀವಕೋಶ ನಾಲ್ಕು ಜೀವಕೋಶಗಳನ್ನು ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ; ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದರಲ್ಲೂ ಅರ್ಧ ವರ್ಣತಂತುಗಳು, ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸ. ಹೀಗೆ ಪ್ರತಿ ಪೀಳಿಗೆಯಲ್ಲೂ ವರ್ಣತಂತು ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ ಸ್ಥಿರವಾಗಿರುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: Meiosis II starts immediately after cytokinesis, usually before the chromosomes have fully elongated, and resembles a normal mitosis. Prophase II: the nuclear membrane disappears and chromosomes become compact again. Metaphase II: chromosomes align at the equator, and microtubules from opposite poles attach to the kinetochores of sister chromatids. Anaphase II: the centromere of each chromosome splits and the sister chromatids move to opposite poles. Telophase II: the two groups of chromosomes are enclosed by nuclear envelopes; cytokinesis follows, giving a tetrad of four haploid daughter cells.

points.en: Meiosis II is like mitosis but in haploid cells.
Anaphase II: centromeres split; sister chromatids separate.
End product: four haploid cells (tetrad of cells).

narration.kn: ಅರ್ಧಸೂತ್ರ ವಿಭಜನೆ II ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಸಮಸೂತ್ರ ವಿಭಜನೆಯಂತೆಯೇ ಇದೆ. ಉತ್ತರಾವಸ್ಥೆ II ನಲ್ಲಿ ಸೆಂಟ್ರೋಮಿಯರ್ ವಿಭಜನೆಯಾಗಿ ಸಹೋದರ ಕ್ರೊಮ್ಯಾಟಿಡ್‌ಗಳು ಬೇರ್ಪಡುತ್ತವೆ. ಕೊನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ನಾಲ್ಕು ಏಕಗುಣಿತ ಜೀವಕೋಶಗಳು ಉಂಟಾಗುತ್ತವೆ.

narration.en: Let us follow a cell with 2n = 4 through both divisions.

say.en: Start with a diploid meiocyte with two pairs of homologues, each chromosome already copied into two chromatids: 2n, 4C.
Meiosis I separates the homologues. Each daughter cell is haploid, but every chromosome still has two chromatids: n, 2C.
Meiosis II is like mitosis: centromeres split and sister chromatids separate. One meiocyte gives four haploid cells.
So meiosis keeps the chromosome number constant from one generation to the next, and crossing over plus independent assortment create variation.

body.en: Meiosis is the mechanism by which the specific chromosome number of each species is conserved across generations in sexually reproducing organisms, even though, paradoxically, the process itself halves the chromosome number. It also increases the genetic variability in the population from one generation to the next. Variations are very important for the process of evolution.

points.en: Conserves the chromosome number across generations.
Creates variation through crossing over and independent assortment of homologues.

problem.en: A cell of an organism with 2n = 8 has 2C DNA in G1. Give the DNA content after S phase, after meiosis I and after meiosis II, and the chromosome number in the final cells.

steps.en: After S phase DNA doubles: 4C (chromosome number still 2n = 8).
Meiosis I halves both: 2C DNA per cell, n = 4 chromosomes (each with two chromatids).
Meiosis II separates sister chromatids: C DNA per cell, n = 4 chromosomes.

points.en: Meiosis II is mitosis-like; centromeres split in anaphase II.
points.kn: ಅರ್ಧಸೂತ್ರ ವಿಭಜನೆ II ಸಮಸೂತ್ರ ವಿಭಜನೆಯಂತೆ; ಉತ್ತರಾವಸ್ಥೆ II ನಲ್ಲಿ ಸೆಂಟ್ರೋಮಿಯರ್ ವಿಭಜನೆ.

points.en: One meiocyte gives four haploid cells.
DNA: 2C (G1) → 4C (S) → 2C (after meiosis I) → C (after meiosis II).
Meiosis conserves the chromosome number and creates variation.
